kaori_1.m: You are not welcome here. Please leave now.
r: Why is everyone in Vilegard so afraid of outsiders?
Jolnor asked me to talk to you.

kaori_10.m: If you really want to prove to me that you are not a spy from Feygard, there actually is something that you can do for me.

kaori_11.m: Up until recently, we have been using special potions made of ground bones for healing. These were very potent healing potions, and were used for several purposes.

kaori_12.m: But now, they have been banned by Lord Geomyr, and most use of them has stopped.

kaori_13.m: I would really like to have a few more of those. If you can bring me 10 bonemeal potions, I might consider trusting you a bit more.
r: OK. I will get some potions for you.
No. If they are banned, there is most likely a good reason behind it. You shouldn't use them.
I already have some of those potions with me that you can have.

kaori_14.m: Well, hurry up. I really need them soon.

kaori_2.m: I don't want to talk to you. Go talk to Jolnor in the chapel if you want to help us.

kaori_21.m: Yes, these will do fine. Thank you a lot kid. Maybe you are OK after all. May the Shadow watch over you.

kaori_3.m: He did? I guess you are not as bad as I first thought.

kaori_4.m: I am still not convinced that you are not a spy from Feygard sent to cause mischief.
r: What can you tell me about Vilegard?
I can assure you that I am not a spy.
Feygard, where or what is that?

kaori_5.m: Hmm. Maybe not. But then again, maybe you are. I am still not sure.
r: Is there anything I can do to gain your trust?
[Bribe] How would 100 gold sound? Could that help you to trust me?

kaori_bribe.m: Are you trying to bribe me, kid? That won't work on me. What use would I have for gold if you actually were a spy?
r: Is there anything I can do to gain your trust?

kaori_default_1.m: Was there something you wanted to talk about?
r: What can you tell me about Vilegard?
Why is everyone in Vilegard so afraid of outsiders?

kaori_return_1.m: Hello again. Have you found those 10 bonemeal potions I asked for?
r: No, I am still looking for them.
No. If they are banned, there is most likely a good reason behind it. You shouldn't use them.

kaori_trust_1.m: I still don't fully trust you enough to talk about that.
r: Is there anything I can do to gain your trust?
[Bribe] How would 100 gold sound? Could that help you to trust me?

kaori_vilegard_1.m: You should go talk to Erttu if you want the background story about Vilegard. She has been around here far longer than me.

kaori_vilegard_2.m: We have a history of people coming here and causing mischief. Over time, we have learned that keeping to ourselves works best.
r: That sounds like a good idea.

kaori_vilegard_3.m: Anyway, that's why we are so suspicious of outsiders.

kaori.5: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel wants me to talk to Kaori in northern Vilegard, to see if she wants any help.
kaori.10: Kaori in northern Vilegard wants me to bring her 10 bonemeal potions.
kaori.20: I have brought 10 bonemeal potions to Kaori.

vilegard.10: The people of Vilegard are very suspicious of outsiders. I was told to go see Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel if I want to gain their trust.
vilegard.20: I have talked to Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel. He suggests I help three influential people in order to gain the trust of the people in Vilegard. I should help Kaori, Wrye and Jolnor in Vilegard.
vilegard.30: I have helped all three people in Vilegard that Jolnor suggested. Now the people of Vilegard should trust me more.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
